_comment: Stage 3a/3b NIGHT eye-gate quick-states. Launch review.tscn with --nightgate=1; number keys 1-9 jump to these (banner shows what to judge). EDIT FREELY — fields: label, time (time_of_day 0-24), darkness (night_darkness 0-2: <1 dark-scary, >1 moonlit-bright), floor (night_ambient_floor 0-0.4), mood (0-5), clouds (true/false), coverage (0-1), moonphase (0 new .. 0.5 half .. 1 full; if present the camera aims at the moon). Order applied: mood -> clouds -> darkness/floor -> moonphase -> time. Reloaded each press, so edits apply on the next keypress.

states.label: 4 · FULL MOON, early night (~21h) — camera aims at the moon
6 · HALF MOON (~0h) — terminator down the middle
